answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tundra of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the dune of a task receipt, and the orchard is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
